novelty_search.nearest_result: The two released programs require an externally supplied direction, while the learned two-contrast gate is invalid and descriptively fails held-out construction routing.
novelty_search.new_question: Can literal construction cues supply a transparent, fit-free bank/direction/abstention branch and compose the two unchanged causal writers into one executable?

frozen_selector.normalization: lowercase, trim, and collapse ASCII whitespace only
frozen_selector.rejection: raise on empty/non-string input, ambiguous bank, or competing directions within one bank
frozen_selector.fit: No learned or fitted values. Cue strings are literal clauses of the two registered construction grammars.
frozen_selector.no_rescue: Do not add cues, edit precedence, or change normalization after an audit miss.

tests.exhaustive_text_selector: Correct bank and source-side direction on all base and donor strings for A1/A2/P, and abstain on all C strings: 256 decisions total.
tests.compiled_dispatch_conformance: On deterministic synthetic CPU tensors, each bank route exactly equals its already released direct program and abstain exactly preserves base resid:18; invalid and ambiguous inputs reject.
tests.persisted_causal_dispatch: On the aligned receipt's intervention source side, selector routing chooses own margins for A1/A2/P and base for C; A1/A2 recovery and P reflection retain the released bars and C effect is exactly zero.
tests.scope: Only the registered since/by-last and this/that/present/previous-moment grammars; lexical cues are an explicit interface branch, not an inferred internal task circuit.

bars.conformance: Exact bank/direction metadata, alpha, local contrast, and patched tensor equality to direct calls; abstain max absolute change 0; all rejection checks pass.
bars.causal: Each bank has A1/A2 mean recovery and P mean reflection >=0.75 with direction fraction >=0.75; C normalized effect exactly 0.
bars.price: Zero model forwards, backwards, updates, fit, grid, or root evaluations.

predictions.pred_a_authority_release_and_rows: All immutable hashes, releases, manifests, row hashes, and 128 persisted causal records match.
predictions.pred_b_exhaustive_raw_text_selector: All 256 base/donor text decisions match bank, direction, or abstention exactly.
predictions.pred_c_compiled_dual_program_conformance: The wrapper exactly delegates each selected branch and preserves abstention on CPU tensors, with strict rejection behavior.
predictions.pred_d_persisted_causal_preservation: Automatic routing preserves both programs' A/P effects at the frozen bars.
predictions.pred_e_control_abstention: All C intervention sources abstain and have exactly zero dispatched effect.
predictions.pred_f_zero_forward_price_and_scope: No model work or fitting occurs and the restricted lexical scope is explicit.

terminal.release: A-F pass: publish the fit-free raw-text dual-program selector within registered grammar scope.
terminal.null: Authority/conformance/coverage pass but selector or causal preservation misses.
terminal.invalid: Authority, identity, rejection, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.
